muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿مثل الجنة التي وعد المتقون فيها أنهار﴾: مثل الجنة: mubtadaʾ (subject); التي: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as an adjective; the clause ﴿وعد المتقون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; فيها: a fronted khabar (predicate); أنهار: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الجنة, or the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. هي فيها أنهار ("in it are rivers"), or it falls within the scope of the ṣila, as a repetition of it.
﴿من ماء﴾: an adjective of أنهار.
﴿غير آسن﴾: a second adjective of أنهار.
﴿وأنهار من لبن لم يتغير طعمه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنهار is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first أنهار; من ماء is a naʿt (adjective) [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase in this part of the ayah is ﴿من لبن﴾]; and لم يتغير طعمه is a second naʿt.
﴿وأنهار من خمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنهار is conjoined to the first أنهار; من خمر is a naʿt.
﴿لذة للشاربين﴾: a second naʿt; للشاربين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) لذة; it serves as an adjective of الخمر.
﴿وأنهار من عسل مصفى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنهار is conjoined to the preceding أنهار; من عسل is an adjective; مصفى is an adjective of عسل; and the wāw is a conjunction particle.
﴿ولهم فيها من كل الثمرات﴾: لهم: a fronted khabar; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the khabar is attached to, namely the omitted notion of "being established" (al-istiqrār); the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "أصناف" ("kinds"); من كل الثمرات is a naʿt of the omitted mubtadaʾ.
﴿ومغفرة﴾: conjoined to أصناف, or a mubtadaʾ whose fronted khabar is omitted, i.e. ولهم مغفرة ("and they have forgiveness").
﴿من ربهم﴾: a naʿt of مغفرة.
﴿كمن هو خالد في النار وسقوا ماء حميما فقطع أمعاءهم﴾: كمن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "أمن هو خالد في هذه الجنة حسبما جرى به الوعد، كمن هو خالد في النار" ("Is one who abides forever in this Garden, as the promise has it, like one who abides forever in the Fire?"). Or they are attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿مثل الجنة ...﴾. وسقوا: the wāw is a conjunction; سقوا is a passive past verb (built for an unnamed agent); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ماء: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حميمًا: a naʿt of ماء; فقطع: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قطع أمعاءهم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿ومنهم من يستمع إليك﴾: منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يستمع إليك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى إذا خرجوا من عندك قالوا للذين أوتوا العلم﴾: حتى: a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; إذا: a future adverb containing the sense of condition; the clause خرجوا is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's annexation to it; من عندك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خرجوا; the clause قالوا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; للذين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قالوا; the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾, passive (built for an unnamed agent), is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. The wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and العلم is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ماذا قال آنفا﴾: ما: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; ذا: a relative noun — here — specifically, in the position of nominative as khabar; or ﴿ماذا﴾ is [as a whole] an interrogative noun; آنفًا: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in قال; and it has been said: an adverb (ẓarf).
﴿أولئك الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم واتبعوا أهواءهم﴾: أولئك: mubtadaʾ; الذين: its khabar; the clause ﴿طبع الله على قلوبهم﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿واتبعوا أهواءهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿طبع﴾, falling within the scope of the ṣila.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدى وآتاهم تقواهم﴾: الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿اهتدوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the clause زادهم is the khabar (predicate); هدى: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a tamyīz (specification); آتاهم is conjoined to زادهم; تقواهم: a second mafʿūl bihi; and تقواهم is a maṣdar (verbal noun) annexed to its agent.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿فهل ينظرون إلا الساعة أن تأتيهم بغتة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; هل: an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; ينظرون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); الساعة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن تأتيهم: the interpreted maṣdar is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from الساعة, i.e. "the matter is nothing but that it comes upon them"; بغتة: a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿فهل ينظرون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فقد جاء أشراطها﴾: the fāʾ is causal, giving the reason for the Hour's coming suddenly; قد: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); أشراطها: fāʿil.
﴿فأنى لهم إذا جاءتهم ذكراهم﴾: فأنى: the fāʾ is resumptive; أنى: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), the mubtadaʾ (subject) being implied (muqaddar), i.e. فأنى لهم الإخلاص ("so whence will they have sincerity?"). لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the adverb is attached to. إذا: an adverb of future time in the position of accusative; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "how will they take heed?". جاءتهم: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the third-person pronoun is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذكراهم﴾: fāʿil, nominative by an implied ḍamma, and the pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿أنى لهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿جاءتهم...﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. Or ﴿ذكرى﴾ is the mubtadaʾ of the interrogative noun, and the fāʿil of جاء is an implied pronoun referring to the Hour; the clause ﴿إذا جاءتهم﴾ is then parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فاعلم أنه لا إله إلا الله واستغفر لذنبك وللمؤمنين والمؤمنات﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); اعلم: an imperative verb; أن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun; the clause لا إله إلا الله is its khabar (predicate). لا: the lā of generic negation; إله: the noun of لا; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); الله: the Name of Majesty, a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar of لا; the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of أن; the clause ﴿أنه ...﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿علم﴾; the clause فاعلم has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; ﴿استغفر﴾: an imperative verb; لذنبك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استغفر﴾; ﴿للمؤمنين والمؤمنات﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لذنبك.
﴿والله يعلم متقلبكم ومثواكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلم is the khabar; متقلبكم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مثواكم is conjoined to متقلبكم; the clause ﴿والله يعلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ويقول الذين آمنوا لولا نزلت سورة﴾: يقول: an imperfect verb; الذين: its fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; لولا: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) meaning هلا ("why not"); نزلت: a passive past verb (built for an unnamed agent); سورة: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فإذا أنزلت سورة محكمة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا: a future adverb containing the sense of condition; the clause أنزلت is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's annexation to it; it is a passive past verb; سورة: nāʾib fāʿil; محكمة: an adjective.
﴿وذكر فيها القتال رأيت الذين في قلوبهم مرض﴾: ذكر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أنزلت; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذُكر; القتال: nāʾib fāʿil; the clause رأيت has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في قلوبهم: a fronted khabar (predicate); مرض: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila.
﴿ينظرون﴾: ينظرون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) if the seeing is visual, and a second mafʿūl bihi if the seeing is mental; both readings are intended in the ayah.
﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينظرون﴾.
﴿نظر المغشي﴾: an emphatic mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المغشي, because it is a passive participle.
﴿من الموت﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to المغشي.
﴿فأولى لهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿أولى﴾ admits several analyses:
1 - a mubtadaʾ, with لهم a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar.
2 - the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "العقاب أو الهلاك أولى لهم" ("punishment, or destruction, is more fitting for them"), the lām having the sense of the bāʾ, i.e. "more fitting and more deserved for them".
3 - a mubtadaʾ, with لهم a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it, the lām having the sense of the bāʾ, and طاعة its khabar.
4 - it has also been said that it is a past verb, its fāʿil being an implied pronoun indicated by the context.
5 - it has been said: a verbal noun (ism fiʿl), the lām being for clarification (tabyīn), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, with no grammatical position, and the fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to what is understood from the context.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿طاعة وقول معروف فإذا عزم الأمر فلو صدقوا الله لكان خيرا لهم﴾: ﴿طاعة وقول﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), the khabar (predicate) being omitted, its implied form being "أمثل" ("is better"). Or a khabar whose mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "الأمر" ("the matter"), or "أمرنا طاعة" ("our affair is obedience"). Or a khabar of the preceding ﴿أولى﴾. فإذا: the fāʾ is a conjunction particle; إذا: a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) صدقوا; the clause عزم الأمر is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's annexation to it; the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; لو: conditional, non-jussive; صدقوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of إذا; the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لكان: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "it", i.e. truthfulness; خيرًا: its khabar; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. هل: for interrogation.
﴿عسيتم﴾: a past verb, one of the verbs of hope; the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿إن توليتم﴾: إن: conditional. توليتم: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The conditional sentence with its apodosis is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن تفسدوا في الأرض﴾: the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تفسدوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of عسى, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تفسدوا﴾.
﴿وتقطعوا أرحامكم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أن تفسدوا في الأرض﴾; the clause ﴿فهل عسيتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿أولئك الذين لعنهم الله﴾: أولئك: mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لعنهم الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿فأصمهم وأعمى أبصارهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أصمهم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أعمى أبصارهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فأصمهم.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿أفلا يتدبرون القرآن﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī); the fāʾ conjoins to something implied that the context requires; لا: negative; يتدبرون القرآن: an imperfect verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أم على قلوب أقفالها﴾: أم: disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa), meaning بل ("rather") plus the interrogative hamza; the implied form is: "بل أعلى قلوب أقفالها؟" ("rather, are there locks upon hearts?"). ﴿على قلوب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أقفالها: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), necessarily postponed.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إن الذين ارتدوا على أدبارهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الهدى﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: its noun; the clause ارتدوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. على أدبارهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من بعد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ارتدوا﴾. ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and it, together with what falls within its scope, is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation to the adverb; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبين; الهدى: fāʿil (agent).
﴿الشيطان سول لهم وأملى لهم﴾: الشيطان: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause سول لهم is the khabar (predicate) of الشيطان, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إن; أملى لهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سول لهم.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم قالوا للذين كرهوا ما نزل الله سنطيعكم في بعض الأمر﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); بأنهم: its khabar (predicate); أن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿هم﴾: its noun; the clause قالوا is its khabar; للذين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالوا﴾; the clause كرهوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; ما: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿نزل الله﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. The clause سنطيعكم is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); في بعض الأمر: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نطيعكم.
﴿والله يعلم إسرارهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); الله: mubtadaʾ; the clause يعلم إسرارهم is the khabar; إسرارهم: mafʿūl bihi; it is with a kasra on the hamza, the maṣdar (verbal noun) of أسرّ.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿فكيف إذا توفتهم الملائكة يضربون وجوههم وأدبارهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كيف: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar (predicate), i.e. "how will their state be?", or the object of an omitted verb, i.e. "so how will they act?"; إذا: a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause توفتهم الملائكة is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's annexation to it; the clause يضربون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) or from the object; وجوههم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أدبارهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to وجوههم.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم اتبعوا ما أسخط الله﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); بأنهم: khabar (predicate); the clause اتبعوا is the khabar of أن; ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أسخط الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿وكرهوا رضوانه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause اتبعوا ما أسخط الله.
﴿فأحبط﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿أعمالهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿أم حسب الذين في قلوبهم مرض﴾: أم: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; حسب الذين: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); في قلوبهم: a fronted khabar (predicate); مرض: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿أن لن يخرج الله أضغانهم﴾: أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of حسب; أن is lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); لن: a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; يخرج: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the clause ﴿لن يخرج الله...﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of the lightened أن; الله: fāʿil; أضغانهم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ولو نشاء لأريناكهم فلعرفتهم بسيماهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو: conditional; نشاء: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "we"; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; أريناكهم: a past verb; نا is the fāʿil; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the hāʾ the second; the seeing here is visual, which is why it takes only two objects; the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the lām is conjoined to the first lām occurring in the apodosis, repeated for emphasis; عرفتهم: a verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause لأريناكهم has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of لو, and the clause فلعرفتهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; بسيماهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرفتهم.
﴿ولتعرفنهم في لحن القول والله يعلم أعمالكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction particle; the lām, together with the nūn, occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; تعرفنهم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent, implied as "you"; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; في لحن القول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعرفنهم, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in their being people who speak allusively"; الله: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلم أعمالكم is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿والله يعلم أعمالكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿ولنبلونكم حتى نعلم المجاهدين منكم والصابرين ونبلو أخباركم﴾: the lām occurs, with the nūn, in the answer to an omitted oath; نبلونكم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حتى: a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive, or of cause (taʿlīl) and of the genitive; نعلم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبلونكم﴾; المجاهدين: mafʿūl bihi; ﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الصابرين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المجاهدين; ﴿نبلو﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نعلم﴾; أخباركم: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the clause صدوا عن سبيل الله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause كفروا.
﴿وشاقوا الرسول﴾: also conjoined.
﴿من بعد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شاقوا﴾.
﴿ما تبين﴾: ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival); together with what follows it, it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبين.
﴿الهدى﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿لن يضروا الله شيئا﴾: لن: a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; يضروا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; الله is accusative by way of glorification (ʿalā al-taʿẓīm); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن; شيئًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "anything of harm", and you may also parse it as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وسيحبط أعمالهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction particle; the sīn is a particle of the future; يحبط أعمالهم: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أي: the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين: an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿أطيعوا الله ورسوله ولا تبطلوا أعمالكم﴾: أطيعوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; الله: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); رسوله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الله; the clause ولا تبطلوا is conjoined to the clause أطيعوا; لا: prohibitive; تبطلوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the wāw is the fāʿil; أعمالكم: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; صدوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كفروا; عن سبيل الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صدوا﴾.
﴿ثم ماتوا وهم كفار فلن يغفر الله لهم﴾: ثم: a conjunction particle; ماتوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause فلن يغفر الله لهم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the fāʾ enters because of the sense of condition contained in the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿فلا تهنوا وتدعوا إلى السلم وأنتم الأعلون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition); لا: prohibitive; تهنوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); تدعوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿فلا تهنوا﴾, jussive like it; إلى السلم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعوا﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); أنتم الأعلون: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿والله معكم ولن يتركم أعمالكم﴾: the wāw is also circumstantial; الله: mubtadaʾ; معكم: an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; the wāw is a conjunction; لن: a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; يتركم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; أعمالكم: accusative by removal of the preposition, or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إنما الحياة الدنيا لعب ولهو﴾: إنما: [إنّ] made inoperative (makfūfa) by the preventing [mā] (kāffa); الحياة: mubtadaʾ (subject); الدنيا: a naʿt (adjective), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma; لعب: khabar (predicate); لهو is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لعب.
﴿وإن تؤمنوا وتتقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن: conditional; تؤمنوا: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); تتقوا is conjoined to تؤمنوا.
﴿يؤتكم أجوركم﴾: يؤتكم: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is the first object of يؤتكم, and أجوركم the second object of يؤتكم.
﴿ولا يسألكم أموالكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction particle; لا: negative; يسألكم is conjoined to يؤتكم; the kāf is the first object of يسأل, and أموالكم the second object of يسأل.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿إن يسألكموها﴾: إن: conditional; يسألكموها: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the kāf is its first object and ﴿ها﴾ its second object; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, and the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ).
﴿فيحفكم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the protasis.
﴿تبخلوا﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿ويخرج﴾: conjoined to the apodosis.
﴿أضغانكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) refers to Allah the Exalted.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ها أنتم هؤلاء تدعون﴾: ها: for drawing attention (tanbīh); أنتم: mubtadaʾ (subject); هؤلاء: its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It has also been said: هؤلاء is a relative noun meaning الذين, and it is the khabar, and the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. And it has been said: ها is for drawing attention, أنتم is mubtadaʾ, the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is its khabar, and هؤلاء is the one addressed (munādā), the vocative clause being parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar, with no grammatical position; or هؤلاء is accusative by specialisation (ikhtiṣāṣ) through an implied verb, and the clause of specialisation is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿لتنفقوا﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); تنفقوا: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of cause; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعون﴾.
﴿في سبيل الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنفقوا﴾.
﴿فمنكم من يبخل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿ); ﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; من: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause يبخل is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يبخل فإنما يبخل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من: conditional, mubtadaʾ; يبخل: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; إنما: [إنّ] made inoperative (makfūfa) by the preventing [mā] (kāffa); the clause فإنما with what follows it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يبخل: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿عن نفسه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبخل﴾, because it is made transitive with على and with عن, by virtue of containing the sense of withholding and of transitivity.
﴿والله الغني وأنتم الفقراء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله: mubtadaʾ; الغني: its khabar; the clause ﴿والله الغني﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أنتم الفقراء is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to والله الغني.
﴿وإن تتولوا يستبدل قوما غيركم ثم لا يكونوا أمثالكم﴾: the wāw conjoins to the preceding conditional sentence; إن: conditional; تتولوا: the protasis; the wāw is the fāʿil; يستبدل: the apodosis; قومًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); غيركم: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾; ثم: a particle; لا: negative; يكونوا: conjoined to the apodosis, jussive; the wāw is the noun of يكون, and أمثالكم its khabar.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله﴾: «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «صدوا» is conjoined to «كفروا»; and «عن سبيل الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صدوا».
﴿أضل أعمالهم﴾: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring to Allah the Exalted, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». It has also been said: «الذين» is accusative (manṣūb) by a verb indicated by the one mentioned, i.e.: He sent astray those who disbelieved.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «عملوا الصالحات» is conjoined to «آمنوا».
﴿وآمنوا بما نزل على محمد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «آمنوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا»; «نزل» is a past verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); «على محمد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نزل»; and the clause is conjoined to the ṣila clause before it, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو الحق من ربهم﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ, and «الحق» is its khabar (predicate). «من ربهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وهو الحق...» is parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ, namely His words «والذين آمنوا», and its khabar, namely His words «كفر عنهم سيئاتهم», with no grammatical position.
﴿كفر عنهم سيئاتهم﴾: «كفر» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent. «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كفر». «سيئاتهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is the khabar of «والذين آمنوا».
﴿وأصلح بالهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. «أصلح» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent. «بالهم» is the mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined to «كفر عنهم سيئاتهم».

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الذين كفروا اتبعوا الباطل﴾: «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «بأن»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «أنّ» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the noun of «أنّ»; «كفروا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «اتبعوا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; «الباطل» is the object of «اتبعوا»; the clause «اتبعوا الباطل» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar from «أنّ», its noun and its khabar is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ذلك»; and the nominal clause «ذلك بأن...» is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن الذين آمنوا اتبعوا الحق من ربهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أنّ» is an abrogating particle; «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, the noun of «أنّ»; «آمنوا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; «اتبعوا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; «الحق» is the object of «اتبعوا»; «من ربهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحقّ»; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause «اتبعوا الحق» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «أن»; and the interpreted maṣdar from «أنّ», its noun and its khabar is genitive, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar that is genitive by the bāʾ.
﴿كذلك يضرب الله للناس أمثالهم﴾: «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative, an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: with a striking like that wondrous striking Allah strikes for people their similitudes. «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. «يضرب» is an imperfect verb, nominative; «الله» is the fāʿil; «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يضرب»; «أمثالهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿فإذا لقيتم الذين كفروا فضرب الرقاب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, ordering the command within its scope upon what precedes it; «إذا» is an adverb of future time (ẓarf mustaqbal) containing the meaning of condition, and what governs it is an implied verb, which is [also] what governs «ضرب الرقاب»; the clause «لقيتم» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «الذين» is the object of «لقيتم»; the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ضرب» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; and «الرقاب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿حتى إذا أثخنتموهم فشدوا الوثاق﴾: «حتى» is a particle of inception (ibtidāʾ); it has also been said: a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. «إذا» is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause «أثخنتموهم» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the fāʾ links the answer of «إذا»; and «شدوا الوثاق» is an imperative verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فإما منا بعد وإما فداء﴾: the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿ); «إما» is a particle of condition and detailing; «منًّا» and «فداء» are two maṣdars (verbal nouns), accusative (manṣūb) by a verb that may not be made overt, because whenever a maṣdar is brought to detail the outcome of a clause, it must be made accusative by an implied verb. It has also been said: they are two mafʿūl bihi of an implied governing word (ʿāmil), their implied form being: grant them a favour, and accept from them a ransom. «بعد» is an adverb (ẓarf), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning.
﴿حتى تضع الحرب أوزارها﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit and of the genitive; «تضع» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after «حتى»; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضرب»; «الحرب» is the fāʿil; and «أوزارها» is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ذلك ولو يشاء الله لانتصر منهم﴾: «ذلك» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and it may be made accusative by an omitted verb, i.e.: do that. The wāw is resumptive; «لو» is conditional; «يشاء الله» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the lām is the one occurring in the answer of «لو»; «انتصر» is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e.: Allah the Exalted; and the clause «ولو يشاء الله..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن ليبلو بعضكم ببعض﴾: «لكن»: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) that is inoperative (muhmal), because it is lightened; the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); «يبلو» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: He commanded you to fight; «بعضكم» is the mafʿūl bihi; and «ببعض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يبلو».
﴿والذين قتلوا في سبيل الله فلن يضل أعمالهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ; the clause «قتلوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «في سبيل الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قتلوا»; the fāʾ is linking, because of the meaning of condition contained in the relative noun; «لن» is a particle of negation, accusative and future; «يضل» is an imperfect verb, accusative by «لن», and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); «أعمالهم» is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is the khabar of «الذين».

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿سيهديهم ويصلح بالهم﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; «يهديهم» is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يصلح» is conjoined to «يهدي»; and «بالهم» is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ويدخلهم الجنة عرفها لهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يدخلهم» is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الجنة» is a second mafʿūl bihi by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); and the clause «عرفها لهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is a vocative (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); and «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿تنصروا﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿الله﴾: the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla), mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ينصركم﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿ويثبت أقدامكم﴾: conjoined to the apodosis; and a muḍāf must be [understood as] omitted, i.e.: the religion of Allah and His Messenger.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿والذين كفروا﴾: «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فتعسًا لهم﴾: the fāʾ is linking, by likening the relative noun to the condition; «تعسًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: may they perish a perishing (تعسوا تعسًا); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعسًا», or an adjective of it; and the clause «تعسوا» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «الذين».
﴿وأضل أعمالهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أضل أعمالهم» is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the pronoun is indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause «أضل...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the implied verb «تعسوا».

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿ذلك بأنهم كرهوا ما أنزل الله فأحبط أعمالهم﴾: «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بأنهم» is its khabar (predicate); «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and the clause «كرهوا» is its khabar; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «أنزل الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «فأحبط» is conjoined to «كرهوا», and «أعمالهم» is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿أفلم يسيروا في الأرض﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [to the past] and jussive; «يسيروا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; «في الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسيروا». «فينظروا»: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya).
﴿فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾: «ينظروا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, the implied form being: was there not a journeying, so that there would be a looking? «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative, the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «عاقبة» is its postponed noun; «الذين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «من قبلهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿دمر الله عليهم وللكافرين أمثالها﴾: «دمر الله» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «دمر». The object of «دمر» is omitted, its implied form being: He destroyed their selves, their wealth and what they had built. The clause «دمر الله عليهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «للكافرين» is a fronted khabar, and «أمثالها» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the pronoun refers to the end mentioned before, i.e.: the likes of the end of those before them; or it refers to the destruction understood from His words «دمر الله عليهم».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله مولى الذين آمنوا﴾: «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «بأن» is its khabar (predicate); «الله»: the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the noun of «أن»; and «مولى الذين آمنوا» is the khabar of «أن».
﴿وأن الكافرين﴾: «أن الكافرين» is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿لا مولى لهم﴾: «لا» is the lā of generic negation; «مولى» is its noun, and «لهم» is its khabar; and the clause is the khabar of «أن».

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun, and the clause «يدخل الذين آمنوا» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «عملوا الصالحات» is conjoined to the ṣila and falls within its scope; «جنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is an adjective of «جنات»; and the clause «إن الله يدخل...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين كفروا يتمتعون ويأكلون كما تأكل الأنعام والنار مثوى لهم﴾: «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause «يتمتعون» is the khabar of «الذين»; the clause «يأكلون» is conjoined to the clause «يتمتعون». «كما»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or a ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما» is maṣdariyya; «تأكل الأنعام» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The wāw is resumptive; «النار» is a mubtadaʾ, and «مثوى» is the khabar; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of «مثوى»; and the clause «والنار مثوى لهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وكأين من قرية﴾: «كأين» is predicative (khabariyya); it is a word compounded from the kāf and «أي», meaning the predicative «كم», and its position is nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); «من قرية» is the tamyīz (specification) of the allusive word (kināya).
﴿هي أشد﴾: «هي» is a mubtadaʾ, and «أشد» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is an adjective of «قرية».
﴿قوة﴾: tamyīz.
﴿من قريتك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أشد».
﴿التي أخرجتك أهلكناهم﴾: «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قريتك»; the clause «أخرجتك» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «التي», with no grammatical position. The clause «أهلكناهم» is the khabar of «كأين».
﴿فلا ناصر لهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لا» is the lā of generic negation; «ناصر» is its noun, and «لهم» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿أفمن كان على بينة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted and implied, required by the context; «من» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to «من»; and «على بينة» is the khabar (predicate).
[Translator's note: «من» here is usually parsed as a relative noun, the interrogative force coming from the hamza; translated as written.]
﴿من ربه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «بينة»; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كمن زين له﴾: «كمن»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative, khabar; «من» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «زُيِّنَ», read as passive (constructed for one whose agent is not named), is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «زين».
﴿سوء عمله﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿واتبعوا﴾: conjoined to «زين».
﴿أهواءهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
